posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Oh man, C&A are Rewall fans? This is the best!

Maaan, Sky-Scraper is just the bet. I hope she makes an honest woman out of Paige someday.

Portja is now a bi icon.

Sky-Scraper alone on Christmas because she’s systematically dismantled all her human relationships is the saddest thing ever. ;_;

They set out to make a supporting cast for Sky-Scraper, which consists of government handler, almost-friend, almost-boyfriend, therapist, and I think that puts a fine point on all her personal problems.

“Thank you for grabs.” XD

I’m glad I wasn’t the only one thinking about Hul’s relation to singular entities and the sandwich bag, I think I wrote almost the same letter.

“Did anyone say they wanted to know you?” Cult of Gloom on point with the insults once again.

And good on them for helping combat some of the stigma around therapy and mental health treatment. This was a good episode.

posts.name: OddballPaladin
posts.cooked:
The Hul bit was interesting. Makes me think of the way primordial/titans are treated in games by White Wolf/Onyx Path like Scion and Exalted. In those, the ancient old ones are not just beings, but they’re entire places, universes. They have god-level spawn that are both part of, but independent of, the greater beings. Seems that X-boy is one of those spawn of Hul, and it’s not so much getting through the sandwich bag, as a wireless connection between the two that ignores the space between because they are the same, despite being in different places.

Also, “significant shenanigans” aren’t that off the wall. Even Uncle Ben and Jason Todd came back from the dead.

Hyrax, Lorax, and Average-Elevationrax.

A pine marten’s not a rodent! Mustelids are not rodentia!

Mayor Maeknaught

Ooof, the Department of Exo-Earth Integration
…that didn’t age well…

Wager Master dies a lot…especially on-stage! badum-tish!

Interesting that C&A made a character specifically Ukrainian a full year before the war with Russia broke out.

Name: Sky-Scraper
Alias: Portja Kir-Pro
Species: Thorathian (powered)
Nationality: Earthling

What villain should go to DokThorath? Send me Fright Train, he can help them build a commuter train system, and the trains will all just run on time by default!

“Propagandists Adam and Christopher”

If Aata-Haka had a good enough reason to get back to universe 1, I think he could find a reality outside the sandwich bag which Hul had devoured through an alternate Xxtz’hulissh, get alt-Xxtz to swallow him, travel across whatever unknowable alien landscape exists within Hul, and tear his way out again through the maw of Xxtz-1. The problem is that while Haka’s life is guaranteed against destruction by Arataki’s continued existence, his sanity is not. Even if the purpose of reaching his original home remained intact, the Haka that returned from Hul would not be the person we know and love.

Zhu Long was not from Atlantis. But perhaps he was the direct student of someone who was, or better yet stole the power of one.
